# jSquash WebP

Upstream: https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash/tree/main/packages/webp
Reference release: `@jsquash/webp` 1.5.0. The vendored `meta.js`, `utils.js`,
`codec/enc/webp_enc.js`, and encoder WASM match that release; `encode.js` is a
Tansu adaptation. The original import did not record its precise revision.
